name: The Brotherhood: The Way of the Sleeper
summary:
You are treading on hallowed ground...
Greetings, stranger. I see that you doubt what the henchmen of the archbarons try to sell you as true and just. You know why. Because it's LIES! They tell you that we worship a foolish idol, that our herb clouds the mind, and that our Templars are fanatical murderers. Don't be deceived by their false words! Witness our hospitality for yourself, taste the calming effects of the herb, and perhaps you will be one of the chosen ones to whom the Sleeper reveals himself in a dream...

In 2012, a small group of enthusiasts founded an RPG about the Brotherhood of the Sleeper in the WorldOfGothic subforum. For two years stories of faith, community and steaming root soup, but also of betrayal and the most heinous treachery, grew. Now you can experience these stories for yourselves. THE PATH OF THE SLEEPER (original title - Die Bruderschaft: Der Weg des Schläfers) accompanies the RPG's original members on their adventures within the Barrier. Will the brothers bring freedom to their community, or will they deliver the entire island into the clutches of a malevolent archdemon's madness? Find out!
